title: Reachability after one step
statement: Let $N$ be a finite-state nondeterministic Turing machine with $k$ work tapes, and let $x$ be a Boolean input. If a configuration $C$ has the same machine state, input-head position, work-tape contents and head positions, and output summary as the configuration reached from the initial configuration on $x$ by some finite word of choice bits, then for either choice bit $b$, the configuration obtained by taking one step from $C$ under $b$ also has those same components as a configuration reached from the initial configuration by a finite word of choice bits.
hypotheses_covered: C is a configuration of N on Boolean input x
C is reachable in the sense of equality of core data and output summary with a run from the initial configuration
b is a Boolean choice bit
